cases.cancel_cases: Selected fixed alpha, each direction, cancel next control after first genuine two-velocity overlap; original <=300-control safe handoff +400 retention +100 tail.
cases.selection: Eligible alpha must pass both directions full old physical/task, entry, goal-error, retention and torque-square-MEAN gates, without requiring speed gain. Select minimum max(left cycle s,right cycle s); tie choose lower average of left/right full-scene torque-square MEAN; final tie choose lower alpha. Same alpha in both directions. Publish all attempted candidates. Online selection is provisional until independent saved reader reproduces it; mismatch invalidates result, with no post-hoc alternate candidate.
cases.stop: Any hard safety/native/source/entry failure stops campaign. A controlled safe task failure closes this and all higher-alpha development points; only earlier eligible fixed winner cancellation may continue. No automatic replacement or retry.

gates.nominal_fixed_engineering_gain: Both directions cycle<=.95*old C30 fixed AND <=.90*old zero; no averaging. This is fixed engineering gain, never RL gain.
gates.full_tau2_cost: full_scene_components.torque_normalized_square_mean <=1.10*old fixed AND <=1.20*old zero. Use time mean, not its integral. Report integral separately; neither is energy.
gates.safety: All old audited non-speed gates unchanged including whole-wheel native clearance, load/contact/no unwanted airborne slip, stopped/load handoff, retention, torque/native source/count invariants and entry pairing. Do not loosen thresholds to pass S-curve.

budgets.pure_checks: No fits, model or robot construction. C33 pure_curve_checks_01 completed; only new integration or changed-source checks permitted before physical GO.
